title: Composed supervisory control: Delayed warning with trip lockout and acknowledgement -> First-out fault recorder with deterministic priority

outputs.name: B_AnyFault
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Current aggregate fault input

outputs.name: B_FirstFault
outputs.description: Subsystem B: First fault code: 0 none, 1 A, 2 B, 3 C

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Acknowledge has priority over a new Unacked indication within the same scan.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_WarningCondition shall assert A_Warning only after it remains enabled for 300 ms.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_TripCondition while enabled shall immediately latch A_Trip and A_LockedOut.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A newly asserted A_Warning or A_Trip shall set A_Unacked.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Acknowledge shall clear A_Unacked without clearing active A_Warning or latched A_Trip.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Trip and A_LockedOut only while both conditions and A_Enable are FALSE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Disabling the system shall clear the non-latched A_Warning but not an existing A_Trip.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_AnyFault shall equal the disjunction of all three fault inputs.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: The first observed fault shall latch B_LockedOut and its code in B_FirstFault.
requirements.property: G((!B_LockedOut AND B_AnyFault) -> X(B_LockedOut AND B_FirstFault<>0))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Simultaneous first faults shall use priority A, then B, then C.
requirements.property: G((!B_LockedOut AND B_FaultA)->X(B_FirstFault=1)) AND G((!B_LockedOut AND !B_FaultA AND B_FaultB)->X(B_FirstFault=2))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Later faults shall not overwrite B_FirstFault while B_LockedOut is TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_LockedOut and B_FirstFault only when all fault inputs are FALSE.
A TRUE A_Warning shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
